titleEnglish: Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum — Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan

verses.ar: Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum, Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum
verses.en: O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining — O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining

verses.ar: Allah Say Allah Ki Rehmat Maango
verses.en: Seek the mercy of Allah from Allah

verses.ar:
Ker Dil Ko Ataa Sooz-E-Tawami Yaarab
Her Saans Ho Rehmat Ki Payami Yaarab
Orang-E-Shahee Ki Nahi Haajat Mujh Ko
Kaafi Hai Mohammad Ki Ghulami.. Ya-Rub!
verses.en:
Grant the heart the burning passion of devotion, O Lord
May every breath carry the message of mercy, O Lord
I have no need for the throne of kings
The servitude of Muhammad is sufficient for me — O Lord!

verses.ar:
Wo Nabiyoon Ka Sardaar
Her Aalam Ka Mukhtaar
Tu Saaz Hai Wo Aawaz
Tu Raaz Wo Mehram Raaz
verses.en:
He is the chief of all Prophets
The sovereign of every world
You are the instrument, he is the voice
You are the secret, he is the keeper of secrets

verses.ar:
Tu Lafz Hai Wo Farhang, Tu Haakim Wo Aurang
Tu Lazim Wo Malzoom
Tu Laazim Wo Malzoom
verses.en:
You are the word, he is the meaning; You are the ruler, he is the throne
You are the essential, he is the one entrusted
You are the essential, he is the one entrusted

verses.ar:
Aadat Hai Meri Hadh Say Guzarna Yaarab
Aata He Nahi Mujh Ko The-Herna Yaarab
Herfa-E-Gada Maan-E-Karam Per Tere
Sharminda Sar-E-Hashr Mein Kar Na Ya-Rub!
verses.en:
It is my habit to exceed all limits, O Lord
I have never learned to pause and reflect, O Lord
The beggar's words at your threshold of mercy —
Do not shame me on the Day of Judgement, O Lord!

verses.ar:
Mein Naqsh Hoon Tu Naqqaash
Tu Mul'im Mein Mein Qallash
Mein Aabid Tu Maabood
Mein Sajid Tu Masjood
verses.en:
I am the image, You are the painter
You are the teacher, I am the unruly student
I am the worshipper, You are the worshipped
I am the one who prostrates, You are the one prostrated to

verses.ar:
Mein Jism Aur Tu Dam, Tera Zikr Ilaj-E-Gham
Kyun Dil Ho Mera Maghmor
Kiyoon Dil Ho Mera Maghmoor
verses.en:
I am the body and You are the breath; Your remembrance is the cure for grief
Why should my heart ever be sorrowful?
Why should my heart ever be sorrowful?

verses.ar: Mein Kia Hoon Mein Kiss Shay Ki Talafi Chahoon
verses.en: What am I — what compensation could I ever seek?

verses.ar:
Sana Bashar K Liyeah Hai Bashar Sana K Liyeah
Tamaam Hamd Saza Waar Hai Khuda K Liyeah
Ataa K Samnay Yaarab Khata Ka Zikr Hee Kya
K Tu Ataa K Liyeah Bashar Khata K Liyeah
verses.en:
Praise exists for mankind and mankind exists for praise
All praise is worthy of God alone
In the face of Your gifts, O Lord, what is the mention of sin?
For You are for giving, and mankind is for sinning

verses.ar:
Qounain Ka Masjood Hai Maa'bood Hai Tu
Her Shay Teri Shahid Hai K Mash'hood Hai Tu
Her Aik K Lab Per Hai Teri Hamd O Sana
Her Sooz Mein Her Saaz Mein Moujood Hai Tu
verses.en:
You are worshipped by both worlds, You are the only one worthy of worship
Everything bears witness that You are ever-manifest
On everyone's lips is Your praise and glorification
In every flame and every melody You are present

verses.ar:
Ya Rahim O Ya Rahman
Ya Aadil O Ya Dayyan
Ya Haafiz O Ya Sattar
Ya Wahid O Ya Ghaffar
verses.en:
O Most Merciful, O Most Compassionate
O Most Just, O Recompenser
O Guardian, O Concealer of faults
O The One, O Most Forgiving

verses.ar:
Ya Maalik O Ya Razzaq Tu Khaali E Her Khallaq
Her Raaz Tujhe Malom
Her Raaz Tujhay Maloom
verses.en:
O Master, O Provider — You are free of all creation's need
Every secret is known to You
Every secret is known to You

verses.ar:
Be-Misl Hai Tu La Raib
Tu Paak Hai Tu Be-Aib
Khum Zeest Ka Hai Unwaan
Tu Shaakir E Har Udwaan
verses.en:
You are without equal, beyond all doubt
You are pure, You are without flaw
You are the title of the cup of existence
You are grateful for every hostility overcome

verses.ar:
Teri Zaat Hai Azzo Jal, Tu Her Mushkil Ka Hal
Her Simt Hai Teri Dhom
Her Samt Hai Teri Dhoom
verses.en:
Your being is Mighty and Majestic, You are the solution to every difficulty
In every direction Your splendour resounds
In every direction Your glory resounds

verses.ar:
Rehmat Ki Nigaahon Ka Ishara Maango
Dunya Say Koi Shay Na Khudara Maango
Dunya Ki Wafa Jhoot, Saharay Hein Faraib
Allah Say Allah Ka Sahara Maango
verses.en:
Seek the signal of mercy's glances
Do not seek anything from the world for God's sake
The world's loyalty is a lie, its supports are illusions
Seek Allah's support from Allah alone

verses.ar:
Mansab Ki Karo Chah, Na Sirwat Maango
Tum Ehl-E-Mohabbat Ho Mohabbat Maango
Her Haal Mein Thaamay Hoay Daamaan-E-Raza
verses.en:
Do not desire rank, do not seek wealth
You are people of love — seek love
In every state, hold fast to the hem of Divine pleasure
